title: Elderly Couple at Outdoor Resort, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot depicting an older couple posing outside on a resort lawn. The woman wears a patterned strapless summer dress while the man wears a long-sleeved plaid shirt. Surrounding them in the background are Adirondack chairs, white slatted lawn benches, and tall trees. The photo features deckled edges and punch holes from a vintage photo album.
